name: Joseph Kirchner
headline: Regional Property Manager · Operations Consultant
summary: Property-management professional and independent researcher. Since 2019 I have worked across leasing, renewals, and site management in the Twin Cities, and since 2023 I have managed a regional HUD-assisted portfolio spanning five states. Alongside that work I run a small-business consultancy and write and publish independent research. I am proficient in AppFolio, Yardi, OneSite, and most standard office software, and I bring a talent for communication, team leadership, creative problem solving, and refining systems and procedures for efficiency.

experience.summary: Management of 24 HUD PRAC 202/811 properties, 525 units across five states.
highlights: Hiring and training of on-site staff
Development and monitoring of annual budgets
Resident annual recertifications and site maintenance
Team leadership and policy and procedure development
Leasing, tenant relations, and maintenance coordination and scheduling

experience.summary: Small-business consulting for long-term and short-term clients; part-time since November 2022.
highlights: Daily operations management for a bar and restaurant, food truck, salon, warehouse, and pizzeria
Operational analysis, licensing, fundraising, payroll, hiring and training
Business organization and website construction for small-business owners
Market analyses for renewal rate increases
Drafting, sending, and processing lease renewals
Scheduling and performing tours and lease signings
Conveying rights and responsibilities between clients and tenants
Maintenance scheduling and general office work
English instruction and curriculum composition for primary and secondary students
